list_openai_models: list all available pretrained OpenAI CLIP model names
load_openai_model_by_name: load a pretrained OpenAI CLIP model by name onto the specified device
load_openai_model_from_path: load a CLIP model from a local checkpoint file path
load_openai_model_non_jit: load a CLIP model as a non-JIT state dict for easier modification
load_openai_model_cpu: load a CLIP model onto CPU with float32 dtype patching
